visual_goal: Show four doors drawing on the same vehicle contexts through one controls layer that records recipients, so a source correction can reach copies already delivered.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. Left: a set of stacked database cylinders labeled 'Vehicle contexts'. One arrow right into a tall vertical gate panel with a checklist and a ledger icon, labeled 'Controls'. Right of 'Controls', four doors stacked top to bottom, each with a small icon: a plug labeled 'Data API', a bell labeled 'Events', a stack of files labeled 'Bulk', and a phone labeled 'Consumer'. One arrow from 'Controls' to each of the four doors. Below 'Vehicle contexts', a small pencil-and-document icon labeled 'Source correction', with one orange arrow into 'Controls' labeled 'correction event'. From 'Controls' a dashed orange arrow fans out to the four doors, labeled 'reach every recorded recipient'. These seven labels plus the two arrow labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Vehicle contexts feed one controls layer that serves four doors: Data API, Events, Bulk and Consumer; a source correction enters the controls and a dashed orange arrow reaches every recorded recipient.
